overall_summary: All historical videos currently have extremely low view counts (4 to 20 views) and zero engagement, making statistical confidence very low. However, slightly higher impressions/views occurred on topics related to personal contacts and digital residue ('पुराना नंबर और अधूरा रिश्ता', 'Dil Ki Diary: Bewafai Ka Dard...'). The channel needs broader exploration of relatable triggers while refining short, highly visual hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on phone contacts, names, or chat status (e.g., A_eLARoegnw, a9-G1X5jEOU) yielded the highest initial views (20 and 15 respectively).
winning_patterns.action: Continue leveraging modern smartphone isolation motifs like notifications, saved names, and typing indicators.

weak_patterns.evidence: Openings like 'घंटों से वो ऑनलाइन दिख रहा है।' (WhJ-VwRa3Rg) resulted in the lowest views (4 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive observation hooks; instead, anchor the hook to an active, relatable personal micro-action.

next_video.emotion: Melancholy and sudden realization of being forgotten
next_video.concept: Finding an old bill or a movie ticket in a wallet with two names written on the back, realizing how quickly people become memories.
next_video.opening_direction: Purane wallet se ek 2 saal purana movie ticket nikalna jispar dono ke naam likhe hain.
next_video.twist_direction: Ticket par likha naam ab itna ajnabee lagta hai jaise woh kabhi kisi aur ki zindagi ka hissa tha, apni nahi.
next_video.reason: Evening hours target post-work/night reflection time when loneliness and nostalgia peak among the target audience.

experiment: Testing a tangible physical relic (old movie ticket) instead of a digital phone screen to see if physical triggers outperform digital ones.
